Attention: Please note our age requirement policy: One (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 be present and staying in the property for every three (3) guests between the ages of 15 and 25.





 





Please note: "Blue Dune on 30a" has a 4 night minimum per reservation. 





 







Relaxation and adventure await at our 'Blue Dune' in the beautiful Dune Side Community at Blue Mountain Beach; offering resort accommodations for up to 12 guests in 4 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms.





 







Beach Access: The Blue Mountain Public Beach Access is only 0.5 miles from the home! Simply head South on Dune Side Lane, make a left on US County Highway 30A, then make the following right onto Blue Mountain Road.  Travel East on Blue Mountain Road for about 0.3 mi. and find the Blue Mountain Beach Access on your right.





 



Enjoy our street-legal, 6-seater golf cart AND 6 adult Beach Cruiser bicycles to cruise down 30A in Style!

Quick rides to the beach, Gulf Place, Grayton Beach and more!!



 





Blue Dune' and the Dune Side Community are located less than a 10 minute walk from the Blue Mountain Public Beach Access, a convenient beach access with public restrooms. The bikes provide a short ride to the beach, or you can rent a golf cart from a local vendor and have it delivered right to your doorstep! For a list of recommended vendors, please do not hesitate to give us a call!







 





Dune Side of Blue Mountain Beach is a new upscale resort community located among the highest elevations along 30A. The home also sits within walking (or biking) distance to Point Washington State Park, and its meandering nature trails, with beach access about a half of a mile from the front door!





 





In the fenced-in backyard, you will find a beautiful salt-water pool.  Alternatively, it's only a short walk from the covered front porch to get your toes in the sand!





 





Hardwood floors, modern furnishings and simple coastal decor are just a few of the features that make this home a worthwhile escape. The living room offers comfortable, premium furnishings while the dining area offers seating for 8 with additional seating for 4 at the breakfast bar. The living room leads to a large covered front porch, perfect for the whole family to unwind and enjoy the sea-breeze.





 





The Downstairs King Suite comes with a private, walk-in shower.  All three other bedrooms, including another King Suite, are located on the second floor. The spacious Upstairs King Suite comes with a king bed and opens to a screened and covered private balcony. Enjoy the master's walk-in closet, private master bathroom, and walk-in shower.





 





At the opposite end of the home are the two guest bedrooms and the loft. The first houses a king bed, and the second is a children's bedroom holding a two twin over twin bunks.  In the loft, you'll find a pullout sleeper sofa and flat-screen TV. Both of these bedrooms and the loft share a guest bathroom with a shower/tub combination.





 





Named after the blue lupine flowers that grace its large sand dunes, the coastal village of Blue Mountain Beach lies between Grayton Beach and Gulf Place along the scenic 30A corridor. The village is known for its laid back attitude, locally owned boutiques, eclectic eateries, and boasts the highest views on 30A.





 





30A is a scenic stretch of highway down Florida's beautiful gulf coast between Destin and Panama City Beach. The highway connects the coastal villages of South Walton through the undisturbed beauty of rare dune lakes, sugar white sand, and emerald waters indigenous to the area. Each village has its own unique characteristics that paint a fairy tale like scene against some of the country's most beautiful beaches. Come live the 30A life and experience the beach the way it was meant to be, where Southern Charm meets Bohemian lifestyle and unforgettable vacation memories are created.





 



This home is on our Resort Linen and Terry Package with guaranteed fresh linen and terry placed every turn!

(Excludes Beach Towels)



 



Nearby Restaurants:



Local nearby restaurants include Pizza by the Sea, The Perfect Pig, Sunrise Coffee Co., Goatfeathers Seafood Market, Cafe Tango, Stinky's Fish Camp, The Red Bar, Local Catch Bar and Grill, and Shunk Gulley.





 



Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 12):



- Master Suite I, First Floor: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower





- Master Suite II, Second Floor: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower





- Guest Bedroom I, Second Floor: King Bed, Shared Bath with Shower/Tub Combo





- Guest Bedroom II, Second Floor: Two Twin over Twin Bunks, Shared Bath with Shower/Tub Combo





- Loft, Second Floor: Pullout Couch, Shared Bath with Shower/Tub Combo

Rates, availability and minimum stay requirements are subject to change without notice.





 



Private Pool:





**Blue Dune's private pool can be heated upon request between Oct. 14th - May 12th for $35 a day. If heating of the pool is desired please notify us forty-eight (48) hours in advanced as to allow the pool to reach optimal temperature.  The pool is 5 feet deep max.







 







**The pool will be heated to a maximum of 80 degrees. This cannot be changed and may be less in very cold weather*





 





**** Per State Law all private pools must have alarms on all windows and doors that can led to the pool. This home is equipment with this state required alarm****







 





No Pets: No pets of any kind are permitted in 'Blue Dune .' No exceptions will be made. Guests who violate this policy will be charged an additional $500, plus the expense of steam-cleaning and deodorizing. Violations will result in immediate eviction and forfeiture of rent.

No Smoking: Smoking in any form (e.g. cigarettes, cigars, “e-cigarettes” or “vapes”) are not permitted in 'Blue Dune ' No exceptions will be made. Guests who violate this policy will be charged an additional $500, plus the expense of steam-cleaning and deodorizing. Violations will result in immediate eviction and forfeiture of rent.



Golf Cart: The Golf Cart is provided to the Guest by a 3rd Party Vendor, BeachWalk Vacation Gear, LLC ("BVG, LLC"). The rental policy signed is between the Guest and BVG, LLC. Golf Cart is not owned or provided to the Guest by the Homeowner or BeachWalk Vacation Properties, LLC.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
